description.content: Publishes a new tile version to the registry. If the tile does not yet exist, it will be created automatically. The request body should be a gzipped tar archive (tar.gz) containing the tile manifest (tile.json) and tile contents, e.g. markdown documentation files, eval scenarios, etc. The tile name and version are extracted from the manifest file.
